root_cause.text: The `unpack_pdb()` function in `security/apparmor/policy_unpack.c` fails to validate that the DFA start states, read from untrusted policy data, are within the bounds of the DFA state table before using them as indexes into `dfa->tables[YYTD_ID_BASE]`, resulting in a slab-out-of-bounds read.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "Start states are read from untrusted data and used as indexes into the DFA state tables. The aa_dfa_next() function call in unpack_pdb() will access dfa->tables[YYTD_ID_BASE][start], and if the start state exceeds the number of states in the DFA, this results in an out-of-bound read." The patch adds a bounds check comparing `pdb->start[0]` and `pdb->start[AA_CLASS_FILE]` against `pdb->dfa->tables[YYTD_ID_BASE]->td_lolen`, rejecting policies with out-of-bounds start states.
